title: Fix comment Edit/Delete dropdown menu clipping/overflow issue

requirements.summary: Fix comment action dropdown menu visibility using portal-based rendering or viewport-aware positioning
acceptanceCriteria: The Edit and Delete options in the comment dropdown menu are fully visible for every comment in the list, including those near the bottom or edges of the screen.
The dropdown does not get clipped by any parent container's overflow settings.
The dropdown repositions itself (flips upward or adjusts) when there is insufficient space below the trigger button.
The fix applies consistently across all comment nesting levels (top-level comments and replies).
No regression in existing comment actions (like, report, reply) after the fix.

file_operations.description: Replace the current DropdownMenu implementation with a portal-based approach using shadcn/ui DropdownMenuPortal or implement custom viewport-aware positioning logic. Add collision detection to flip the dropdown upward when near the bottom of the viewport. Ensure the dropdown menu container uses fixed or absolute positioning that is not constrained by parent overflow properties. Test the solution with comments at various scroll positions and nesting levels to verify visibility. Preserve all existing comment action handlers (like, report, reply, edit, delete) without modification.
